text.en:
Upon Sliding:
15% Magazine Refresh, +20 Range, and +30 Stability for 3 seconds or until firing.
<title Only active for the first shot [first shot] />.

Incurs a 0.3 second cooldown after activation but can be reactivated multiple times during a slide by shooting quickly. 

enhanced (
#e Buff Effect is increased.
)

<formula In-Game Range: [range_0] />

title first shot (
Even in the case of burst weapons. Only the first shot of the burst is affected.
)
text.zh-chs:
滑行时：
重新装填 15% 弹匣，+20 射程，+30 稳定性，持续 3 秒或直到开枪。
<title 仅第一发子弹有效 [first bullet only] />。

0.3 秒冷却时间，但一次滑行中快速射击可触发多次该特性效果。

enhanced (
#e 提升增益效果。
)

<formula 有效射程： [range_0] />

title first bullet only (
如果一次射击发射多发子弹，也仅有第一发子弹生效，如脉冲步枪。
)
